posts.author: requiesticat
posts.body:
Hello. I'm Tristan. I joined the forum a few months ago, but have browsed it since 2025. Finding tutorials and references for artwork has been really fun so far. My username is pronounced "re-quee-esty-cat"
I first started playing RPG Maker games around 2015, mainly classics that have been translated on vgperson's website. Ib, The Witch's House, Mad Father, Misao, Paranoiac. Ever since, I've always wanted to create my own horror game with similar themes. I'm currently in the process of developing my first demo, which has
an itch.io page.
The programs I've used are Libresprite, CharaMEL, and VX Ace.
It's nice to meet you all
